_comment: Model assignments for framework (Anthropic OAuth + OpenAI direct API). Roles mirror the upstream oh-my-openagent defaults (see agent-model-requirements.ts), mapped to the newest models each provider exposes via `opencode models`. Tiers: Opus-5 orchestrates the session (sisyphus); Fable-5-1 writes/analyses plans (prometheus, metis); the newest GPT reasoners debug and critique (oracle -> gpt-5.6-pro, momus -> gpt-6-astra, hephaestus -> gpt-5.6-sol); Sonnet-5 drives the plan-executor workers (atlas, sisyphus-junior); Luna-fast handles the cheap parallel search/research workers (explore, librarian); Sonnet-5 handles single-shot media extraction (multimodal-looker). NOTE: frontend-ui-ux-engineer and document-writer are SKILLS (slash commands), not agents, so they have no model slot and are intentionally omitted.
